summary: [Jobber] authorization: OAuth 2.0 via Jobber developer app (client id/secret); scopes configured in Developer Center UI, not as scope= param. Webhook signing key IS the client_secret: HMAC-SHA256(rawBody, client_secret), base64, x-jobber-hmac-sha256, timing-safe compare. Client PII (phones, addresses) is sensitive; request smallest scope.
